dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge following a smooth spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Moderate pixel radius with a rounded shape classification at the highest vertical coordinate.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep leading edge with an approximate 50-degree positive slope relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a moderate radius starting from the blowhole region and terminating at the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 degrees where the melon curvature transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, circular pale lesions or spots are visible on the mid-lateral flank below the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast pigmentation boundary between the dark dorsal region and a bright, light-gray or white lateral field.
